dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Uh-oh, it's Lord Sangemah Bay... I wonder what we're in for this time...

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: #Well hello! Is that {NICKNAME} and our dearest miss expo-manager, Jahoda? You're in luck — I'm offering a whole host of expo-exclusive discounts. Don't miss out!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's not remotely surprised to see Dori here. This event's practically made for her.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Yeah, she attends religiously every year. And she's always the seller who we get the highest number of complaints about...

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Complaints? Hmph, every single Mora I make from this expo is a hundred percent legitimate. I've never broken the rules, and my prices are entirely fair. If people regret their purchases and wanna grumble about it behind my back, that's not my problem.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon can hazard a guess as to why people might be complaining...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I know, and every dispute ends in your favor after you've peppered the buyer with a million and one reasons why you're not in the wrong. It's just...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Could you maybe not find a way to send every single one of your customers complaining to me this time? I'm begging you, Lord Sangemah Bay... For me, please?

choices.text: So that's why you came to see Dori?

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Hmm... How about this? A special opening sale just for Miss Jahoda — fifty percent off! In other words, I'll do my very best to keep the number of complaints down to no more than half of my customers. Sound good?

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Ehh... Works for me, I guess.

choices.text: Just to beg her to rein in the rip-offs?
